jsBoy.subtitle: Enterprise Delivery Management
jsBoy.description: Platform for managing a family delivery business, with client management, delivery agents, orders, pricing and operational tracking.
jsBoy.problem: Manual processes and decentralized information made it hard to track deliveries.
jsBoy.contribution: Building the web application, API and database, with role-based authentication and ongoing evolution of the operational flow.

pokedex.subtitle: Interactive Pokémon catalog
pokedex.description: Modern, responsive Pokédex for exploring, searching, filtering and favoriting Pokémon using real-time data from the PokéAPI.
pokedex.problem: Organizing a large amount of PokéAPI data into a fast, visual and easy-to-explore experience.
pokedex.contribution: Building the Angular application, component architecture, reactive state with Signals, PokéAPI integration, local favorites and unit tests.
